official_faults.description: AMD multi-violation source, unchanged; target part adapted to the competition part

old_faults.description: Reconstructs the three defect mechanisms in the archived old control

clean_guard.description: Fully assigned combinational mux and XOR; no expected lint violations

modulo_guard.description: Intended modulo-256 arithmetic: an overflow warning is not permission to widen the port

scope: Native stdio real MCP calls; no autonomous model or scoring

acceptance.transport: initialize plus actual tool calls succeed
acceptance.session: start/version/part/execute/log/status/stop verified on one owned headless session
acceptance.diagnostics: Positive lint counts required before any zero-count confidence; syntax/ordinary synthesis warnings never establish functional correctness

limits: --state-dir isolates port/session state, but this build also writes command history under /root/.vivado-ai/data; no HOME or global client config changes
No MCP doc search registered; no online KB used
No formal package, baseline, judge, model or instance lifecycle changes
Binary license redistribution not audited; binary excluded from Git
